evidence.computation: Exact Mendelian probabilities and dominant-first phenotype ratios for one through six distinct loci. The kernel composes independent-locus probabilities multiplicatively and checks Hardy-Weinberg frequency bounds.
assumptions: Complete dominance and independent assortment; repeated locus letters are not separate independent loci.
Hardy-Weinberg calculations assume the equilibrium model and the requested allele/phenotype meaning.
The model describes a hypothetical cross, not a prediction establishing biological independence in a real organism.
untrusted: English recognition, locus identity and alignment, choice of model, decimal parsing and JSON framing.

evidence.computation: Lincoln-Petersen or Chapman mark-recapture estimates, density, survival and mortality. Recaptured marked animals cannot exceed either source count; survivors cannot exceed the starting population.
assumptions: The supplied counts denote the specified marked, captured, recaptured or surviving groups.
Population estimates additionally require the sampling assumptions of the chosen model; arithmetic does not establish those ecological conditions.
untrusted: English role assignment, supplied observations, units and JSON framing.

evidence.computation: Standard genetic code from the first base, with explicit template/coding strand and 5-prime/3-prime orientation normalized by the extracted kernel. Strand reversal plus direction reversal preserves the normalized input.
assumptions: One unambiguous sequence and strand role; absent orientation retains the documented 5-prime to 3-prime convention.
Only the standard genetic code and first-base frame; explicitly incompatible models decline.
untrusted: English strand role, orientation and genetic-code recognition; source codon table and framing.

evidence.computation: CFU equals colonies divided by dilution times plated volume. The kernel enforces nonnegative colony counts, dilution in (0,1], positive volume and nonnegative concentration.
assumptions: Colony count and plated volume are explicitly supplied and uniquely assigned; units are converted to mL.
The concentration estimator uses the supplied dilution and plate count without certifying sampling validity.
untrusted: Shared exact numeric tokenization, English quantity-role binding, physical observations and framing.

evidence.computation: Certified continuous exponential and logistic population trajectories, and instantaneous rate at a requested time. The rate uses N(t), not the initial N0; interval error is inherited by both quantities.
assumptions: Population and elapsed time are nonnegative; logistic carrying capacity is positive.

Exponential intrinsic rate may be signed. Forward logistic trajectories permit signed rates at or below capacity; above capacity a negative intrinsic rate is excluded because finite-time divergence can occur.
Zero initial population is the zero equilibrium. Parameter declarations and requested target are separate roles; rate and time must use compatible units.
untrusted: English quantity roles, target clause and unit interpretation; shared exact numeric parsing and framing.
